read_listing.description: Open a category / search URL (or search words -> search.php?search_query=) and read every listing: title, price ('Was' is a reference), stock, buyable (Add to cart) vs build-your-own base price (Configure), condition. Read-only.

inputs.query: a pcserverandparts.com URL, or search words

steps: Human pause, then navigate the bound tab to the URL; wait for listing (or the page's 'Not Found').

Search words (not a URL): type them into site_search like a person (click, clear, varied speed), check the box holds them and search_submit is uncovered, trusted click; results = search.php?search_query=. If typing can't reach the page, open the search URL and record it.
Read down with wheel flicks to the page end.
Read every listing; follow next_page if present (max_pages).
NEVER click Add to cart or Configure.
read_listing.evidence: Each listing has an entity id and a price or is marked without one.
